claim: Annual OPEX does not scale with CAPEX scenario (low/base/high use same OPEX)
residual_risk: Narrative drift can confuse thesis readers
recommended_action: Keep paired low/base/high OPEX reporting and cite source fields explicitly

claim: FCI-dependent OPEX components are computed from central FCI only
recommended_action: Keep FCI-variant recomputation tests and expose FCI used per variant in report

claim: Variable costs are missing (electricity/water/biogas/cooling all zero)
classification: True in historical baseline and fixed now
recommended_action: Mark historical run as superseded and keep canonical utility-column checks

claim: Electricity sale credit is not netted against electricity purchase in OPEX/LCOH
residual_risk: Overstates gross electricity cost; inconsistent economics semantics
recommended_action: Add explicit electricity purchase/sale terms in OPEX and propagate to LCOH

claim: LCOH uses incomplete OPEX (fixed-only or unlabeled variable breakdown)
classification: True in historical baseline and fixed now
residual_risk: Legacy outputs with zero component tags remain in archive
recommended_action: Preserve lcoh_component tagging and validation in OPEX config

claim: LCOH is only produced for central CAPEX (no low/high variants)
recommended_action: Keep variant-generation tests and fail-fast on missing variants

claim: Pathway variable-cost allocation is not causal (falls back to pro-rata by H2)
residual_risk: Pathway rankings can be biased vs physics-causal allocation
recommended_action: Implement pathway-causal variable OPEX allocation (PEM/SOEC/ATR specific)

claim: Dual-tier timestep PPA pricing is not applied in economics module
residual_risk: Electricity cost can deviate materially from dispatch economics
recommended_action: Use timestep-level PPA and spot-credit aggregation for economic reports
